name: United States
access: Reg SHO locate requirement; Rule 201 price test after a 10% decline; threshold securities lists; the deepest stock-lending market. No stamp duty; SEC fee on sells is inside the commission figure.
data_notes: Prices from 1980. Screener returns OTC (PNK, OQX) listings; only the five listed exchanges are kept. ADRs of foreign issuers excluded by issuer country.
